summary: This article explains how sleep helps the brain store memories, helps the body grow and heal, and how screens and daily habits affect a good night's rest.
introduce: Drop a pencil and ask, “What was the cause? What was the effect?” to model the idea quickly. Then show the title “Why We Need Sleep” and tell students to look for things in the article that make other things happen.

keyTerms.def: a set of events that happens again and again in the same order
a chemical made inside the body that carries messages and controls how the body works
a hormone that the brain makes when it gets dark to help you feel sleepy

challengeTerms.def: to make something stronger and more lasting by joining or organizing it
describing the body's natural daily cycle of about 24 hours
the state of not having enough of something that you need

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that getting enough sleep is just as important as doing your homework? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain how sleep helps a student do well in school.
struggling: Pre-teach cycle, hormone, and melatonin with pictures or gestures, then let weak readers match cause cards to effect cards from the article with a partner.
gifted: Ask strong readers to read a challenging version and write a short paragraph that uses consolidate, circadian, and deprivation to explain one important cause-and-effect chain from the article.
